content.text: ▪︎impaired migration of cerumen from TM & out auditory canal
: ear canal stenosis, use of foreign objects (hearing aids,
earbuds, Q-tips), eczema, seborrheic dermatitis, elderly & peds
: clinical (otoscope) ⇢ tightly packed cerumen that partially/completely obstructs auditory canal/TM
: S. aureus, Proteus mirabilis, E. coli, Aspergillus (fungi)
: ⇡ moisture (swimming, humid), trauma (cleaning, Q-tips, hearing aids, earplugs), immunosuppression (HIV)
pain w/ ear canal traction (pulling up & back)
: avoid swimming, keep ears dry, avoid cotton swabs & scratching ear canal
: severe variant of acute otitis externa;
granulation tissue at EAC cartilage-bone junction
⇢ bone erosion, soft tissue involvement, intracranial extension, abscess
Granulation tissue/ear drainage culture prior to initiating empiric ABX
